pages.text: The Electric Oven accepts TFC heating recipes and FirmaLife oven recipes. It has 6 processing slots, supports automated input and output, outputs only completed products, and preserves its stored energy when broken.
The default recipe requires Immersive Engineering. Once Immersive Engineering is installed, the recipe appears in the crafting table and JEI.

pages.title: Operating Parameters
pages.text: $(li)Stores 16000 FE and accepts up to 256 FE/t for input and output. $()$(li)Uses 20 FE/t by default; this is configurable. $()$(li)Target temperature ranges from 0 to 800°C. While powered, it approaches the target by 3°C per tick; while unpowered, it cools by 1.5°C per tick. $()$(li)Food baked by the oven receives the Electric Oven Baked trait with a 0.9x decay modifier. $()
